points.description: Names windrow composting (windrows / turned piles in long rows) as one type.
Names static aerated piles (aerated static pile) as one type.
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'static pile' without aeration is given.

points.description: Names in-vessel composting (enclosed reactor/container/vessel system) as one type.

rubric.notes: One point per listed system, marks shared about equally; clear synonyms (e.g. aerated static pile, enclosed reactor/vessel) are accepted. Total of 2 marks: all three types = 2, two = about 1.33 (round to 1), one = about 0.67 (round to 1 or 0 per teacher practice), none = 0. Vermicomposting does not earn marks; other wrong items earn nothing but do not remove marks for correct ones.
